DC-7 (RESMON_CONFIG_RELOADED) has no reachable trigger on rk3568: the only production caller of Plugin::OnConfigUpdate is core/param_update/src/param_manager.cpp:110, which needs a common event usual.event.DUE_SA_CFG_UPDATED with type=HIVIEWPARA plus PUBKEY_PATH [证书文件] and [证书文件]/[证书文件] under [敏感路径] - none exist on this board (boot log: SubscriberEvent failed); cem publish cannot set the type parameter; no SIGHUP or watcher path exists. Fixing both requires the user-approved option-C self-polling hot reload in resource_monitor_plugin.cpp OnTimerTick, i.e. a functional code change, which advance.py check_code_drift REFUSES after P2 unless repair/reset is run. User decision (2026-09-24): accept P6 stopping at DC-7/DC-8 - no code change, no repair, no reset, no re-walk; P0-P5 stay PASS; P6 gate is run once for machine-produced evidence and the run halts at P6 with a written report. Deliverable is not ready to ship - AC-7 is unimplemented at runtime and is documented as follow-up work in DEVIATIONS.md section C.
